t.zh: 元件只处理第一个目标，几个目标要做同样的事时，同样的元件得接几遍。新元件<part-ref to="part:each"></part-ref>：框里的元件对每个目标各做一遍，每次只看那一个目标。
t.en: A part only works on the first goal, so when several goals need the same done, the same parts would be wired several times. A new part, <part-ref to="part:each"></part-ref>: the parts inside run once on each goal, seeing only that goal each time.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，最多用 4 个元件，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant of at most 4 parts that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 拼成以后的两个目标，要做的是同一件事。
hint.en: The two goals after the join need the same thing done.
